V. The Relationship Between Local Short-Term Uses of Man's Environment and the Maintenance and Enhancement of Long-Term Productivity.
Implementation of the proposed regulations will serve to make for-hire motor carrier operations more responsive to changing demographic and economic conditions; thereby potentially fostering more efficient operations.
VI. Irreversible and Irretrievable Commitments of Resources Which
Would Be Involved Should the Proposed Action be Implemented.
The elimination of extra mileage and some interlining should have the effect of reducing fuel consumption and saving an indeterminable amount of natural resources. This will occur to the extent it is not offset by increases in less efficient exempt local operations brought about by increased competition for an expanded market.
